photos.subject: The founder holds a jar of fig jam in her kitchen.
photos.people: A woman in a green apron stands at a kitchen counter, smiling at the camera, holding a glass jar at chest height in her right hand; short dark hair, freckles, rolled sleeves.
photos.held_object: a glass jar of fig jam with a cream paper label
weaknesses: kettle and cables on the counter

concepts.title: Same kitchen, cleared and regraded
changes: clutter removed from the counter: kettle, cables, mugs
regrade to warm daylight with natural contrast
never_changes: the jar held and its label
the kitchen setting and the crop
concepts.text_zone: upper third, over the plain wall
concepts.prompt:
edit level: 30% of the frame changes, regrade and clutter removed, setting and crop kept.
keep: her face and expression, her pose, both hands with five fingers each, the glass jar she holds and its paper label, exactly as in the photo.
transform: kettle, cables and mugs are removed from the counter, the counter stays bare oak; the light becomes warm late-morning daylight from the window.
people: the same woman, green apron, short dark hair, freckles, smiling, the jar at chest height in her right hand; skin texture, hair strands and apron creases stay as they are. No other person enters the frame.
text zone: the plain wall in the upper third stays calm and empty for the headline added later.
grade: warm, natural contrast, true skin tones.
Avoid: no text, no letters, no logo, no extra people, no extra fingers, no skin smoothing, no change to the face or the jar.

never_changes: the jar held and its label

keep: her face and expression, her pose, both hands with five fingers each, the glass jar she holds and its paper label, exactly as in the photo.

people: the same woman, green apron, short dark hair, freckles, smiling, the jar at chest height in her right hand; skin texture, hair strands and apron creases stay as they are. No other person enters the frame.
